scanner.reason: The required BoxClaw scanner expects a repository with frontend/ and backend/ directories. This project is an intentionally independent no-build static SPA with index.html, app.js, styles.css and assets/.

observed_boundary.backend: local BoxClaw adapter lives outside this repository; storefront proxy forwards to admin-backend 8001

frozen_interactions: Year -> Make -> Model -> Trim -> Drive vehicle selector
Product gallery, price, ratings, reviews and related products
Add to cart, buy now, checkout and existing modal state
Home, store, cart and product hash routes

new_flow.billing: officially sponsored by F-Box; no customer credits, price, plan or charge fields are sent by the browser
new_flow.local_mode: the 4174 adapter calls BoxClaw first; when 8001 is mock or has no enabled image route, it falls back to a deterministic layout preview explicitly labeled as local
